official_sources.title: GDAL vector rasterize
official_sources.finding: Default rasterization and ALL_TOUCHED select different boundary pixels; ALL_TOUCHED can also make input feature order affect edge results.
official_sources.limitation: Rasterization semantics are QA rules; the target parcel geometry and raster grid still require canonical execution.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal_rasterize
official_sources.finding: Default polygon burning selects center-contained pixels while -at selects touched pixels; feature order can control edge burn values.
official_sources.limitation: The terminal parcel policy must explicitly choose and record one membership rule.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL rasterization C API
official_sources.finding: Rasterization transforms geometry coordinates into raster pixel/line space and exposes ALL_TOUCHED and merge-algorithm controls.
official_sources.limitation: The dataset geotransform and exact geometry CRS still need runtime binding.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdalwarp
official_sources.finding: Warp/cutline processing exposes cutline CRS, resampling, overview selection, error threshold and target-aligned-pixel controls that can change derived pixels.
official_sources.limitation: Warped/cutline output is derived and must not silently replace native parcel-cell evidence.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDALWarpOptions
official_sources.finding: CUTLINE_ALL_TOUCHED defaults false; when true every pixel overlapping the cutline can be selected rather than center-contained pixels.
official_sources.limitation: The chosen cutline rule must be pinned and independently replayed.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL Warper C++ API
official_sources.finding: Cutline coordinates, nodata unification and chunk-dependent resampling scale are executable warp semantics that affect reproducibility.
official_sources.limitation: Warp QA is not a substitute for native full-resolution parcel sampling.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster clip
official_sources.finding: Raster clip preserves original resolution and rounds bounds to whole pixels; geometry clipping selects overlapping pixels and requires explicit geometry CRS.
official_sources.limitation: Overlap-based clipping is a derived selection rule and must not be confused with center-membership policy.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector clip
official_sources.finding: Vector clipping can split collections, promote geometry types and union template geometries; gaps can make unions imperfect.
official_sources.limitation: Clipping transformations must not alter canonical parcel identity without a digest comparison.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL Geometry Validity
official_sources.finding: Invalid geometries can yield incorrect intersection results; geometry validity alone does not detect inter-feature gaps or overlaps.
official_sources.limitation: Validity is necessary but does not prove coverage topology or cadastral correctness.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector check-geometry
official_sources.finding: check-geometry tests OGC Simple Features validity and simplicity and can emit invalid geometry evidence.
official_sources.limitation: A valid result does not verify parcel source authority or inter-feature coverage.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector make-valid
official_sources.finding: MakeValid linework and structure methods can produce different valid geometries; lower-dimensional components may be removed.
official_sources.limitation: Canonical geometry must not be silently repaired; any repair requires before/after digest and area/topology ledger.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector check-coverage
official_sources.finding: Coverage validity checks overlaps, shared-edge node consistency and gaps above a configured width.
official_sources.limitation: Coverage checks assume individually valid polygons and do not establish legal parcel authority.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector clean-coverage
official_sources.finding: Coverage cleaning changes boundaries using snapping, gap closure and overlap merge strategies.
official_sources.limitation: Cleaning is a derived repair and cannot silently modify the canonical target parcel.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal vector simplify-coverage
official_sources.finding: Coverage simplification preserves shared boundaries but changes vertices and does not repair pre-existing gaps/overlaps.
official_sources.limitation: Simplified geometry is not terminal canonical boundary evidence.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OGRGeometry class
official_sources.finding: OGR geometry operations expose validity, MakeValid methods and canonical normalization behavior backed by GEOS.
official_sources.limitation: Library version and GEOS build must be frozen for deterministic repair/replay.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OGRPolygon class
official_sources.finding: Polygon validity and MakeValid can change ring winding, duplicate points or geometry dimensionality even when producing a valid result.
official_sources.limitation: Topologically equivalent output may still differ byte-for-byte; both semantic and digest checks are needed.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL Python utilities API
official_sources.finding: Python RasterizeOptions exposes allTouched, burn values, attributes and SQL/where selection, all of which affect the generated mask.
official_sources.limitation: Runtime options must be recorded rather than inferred from defaults.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 59.1 utilities as a library
official_sources.finding: Library rasterization options include targetAlignedPixels, inverse and allTouched, making grid and mask semantics explicit API inputs.
official_sources.limitation: Application wrappers must preserve the same options in replay.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL raster pipeline
official_sources.finding: Raster pipeline reprojection exposes resampling, resolution, target-aligned pixels, nodata and error-threshold controls.
official_sources.limitation: Pipeline convenience does not make derived grids equivalent to native source cells.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL vector pipeline
official_sources.finding: Vector pipeline can sequence clipping and validity repair, so transformation order itself becomes geometry provenance.
official_sources.limitation: Pipeline ordering must be fixed and canonical geometry preserved outside explicit QA copies.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply
